title: The Oath
subtitle: requiresStage, and the task that reads it
description: `requiresStage` is the one gate that is per player rather than per team: this quest is open to a player carrying `first_light:sworn` and locked to one without it, even in the same party. The stage task beside it asks the same question as a task — the read half of the feature whose write half was the calling's reward.
Nothing validates that a stage exists, because a stage exists by being granted; a typo shows up as a quest nobody can open rather than as a file that will not load.
